name: PresenceIndicator
summary: Live state for one or more users on a surface. Three forms — dot (small ring-bordered colored circle at the corner of an Avatar), inline (chip with text label + dot), avatar-group (live AvatarGroup with presence dots on each + 'editing N seconds ago'). Distinct from Avatar's presence prop — PresenceIndicator can stand alone in a Toolbar or above a Drawer.

users.description: Array of { name, avatarUrl?, status: 'online' | 'idle' | 'dnd' | 'offline', activity? }.

showActivity.description: Show '{name} is editing' style line beneath the group.

rules: Aggregate aria-label announces who is here ('3 people viewing: Avery Mercer, Kai Morgan, and 1 more').
Per-user presence dot has aria-label='{name}, online' attached to its parent Avatar.
Activity line uses aria-live='polite' so SR users hear new edits.

do: Cap visible avatars at 3-4; '+N' overflow chip.
Use the same status colors as Avatar (online=accent, idle=warning, dnd=danger, offline=neutral).
Activity line: '{name} is editing' truncated to 1 line.
dont: Don't show offline users by default in avatar-group — clutter without value.
Don't ring-pulse online dots (the LiveDot's pulse is for freshness, not for human presence).
